prompts: Can you check this recent payment reply from a customer and tell me what next steps we should take?
I'd like to generate a polite reminder email for an invoice that's about 35 days overdue. Can you help with that?
Could you create a Zendesk ticket with the details of this overdue invoice and notify our Slack team about it?
Please verify if the amount the customer paid matches the invoice total recorded in Stripe, and let me know if there are any discrepancies.
Let's update the status of this Salesforce task related to an overdue invoice and add any relevant notes.

inputParams.paramDescription:
Send a message notifying about the newly created Zendesk ticket. Format it exactly like this, with each field on its own line:

New Zendesk Ticket:
Ticket ID: [ticket id]
Subject: [subject]
Requester: [requester name/email]
Priority: [priority level]
Status: [status]
Description: [brief description from the email]
Extract all details from the email that generated the ticket.

Use emoji if applicable

optional_extracted_args: mrkdwn: boolean // `true` by default. Pass `false` to disable Slack markup parsing. [See docs here](https://api.slack.com/reference/surfaces/formatting)
post_at: string // Messages can only be scheduled up to 120 days in advance, and cannot be scheduled for the past. The datetime should be in ISO 8601 format. (Example: `2014-01-01T00:00:00Z`)
include_sent_via_pipedream_flag: boolean // Defaults to `true`, includes a link to Pipedream at the end of your Slack message.
customizeBotSettings: boolean // Customize the username and/or icon of the Bot
replyToThread: boolean // Reply to an existing thread
addMessageMetadata: boolean // Set the metadata event type and payload
configureUnfurlSettings: boolean // Configure settings for unfurling links and media

conversation: string // Select a public or private channel, or a user or group. In order to list a Slack channel, **your bot must be a member of that channel**, and in order to list private channels, your bot must have the `groups:read` scope in the `OAuth & Permissions` settings in Slack for this bot.

text: string // Text of the message to send (see Slack's [formatting docs](https://api.slack.com/reference/surfaces/formatting)). This field is usually necessary, unless you're providing only attachments instead.
